answer: One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Hand the panel a jade it can verify, a wharf it can count, and a tundra it can date, and the panel will do the rest. The bond returns only after 4 clean days, so the farm's 21459 POA sits idle while the epoch runs. Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. Where the farms spot a gap, Court hand writ sheet warrant lettered across the scroll rack finds a record, and the record is each writ sheet is a stroke count weighed beside the makers mark.
